text:
jen: Hey @sam-cust, saw your ticket — vectors/sec dropped ~60% since 03:00 UTC, tokens/sec steady. Can you share request samples? :coffee:

sam-cust: sending excerpts. Most requests are embeddings with dim=1536. We also see intermittent 400 dim_mismatch for ~0.5% of calls. No change in client libs.

jen: Thanks. Pasted sample: {"input":"<redacted>", "model":"openembed-1536", "output_dim":1536} — all look normal.

alex: Alert from metrics: GPU queue depth on xgpu-03 spiked at 03:02, sustained 8s p95 wait. kvcache hits unaffected. Batching window decreased from 8ms to 4ms around 02:58 per rollout logs.

deploy-bot: rollout v2.14.1 -> eng-runtime started at 02:57, change: "batching: adaptive-window tweak". See https://deploys.example/rollouts/1923

mike: That adaptive tweak clamps max batch wait to 4ms for small seqs — could reduce batch efficiency for embeddings with short tokens but high vector cost. Might explain vectors/sec fall while token throughput steady. :thinking:

jen: Repro steps I ran on staging:
1) curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/embeddings -d @sample.json -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'  --repeat 100k
2) measure client-side vectors/sec
3) observe ~30% drop when adaptive-window enabled

Logs (excerpt):
```
[03:02:01] batch created size=2 wait=3ms kernel_calls=48
[03:02:01] batch created size=1 wait=1ms kernel_calls=24
```

mike: Can you attach pprof/trace from runtime? Also want metric queries for 02:50-03:10: `batch_efficiency`, `vector_rate`, `gpu_queue_depth`.

jen: Attached graphs (link). batch_efficiency dropped 0.45 -> 0.18. gpu_util unchanged but queue_depth increased from p50~0->p95~8.

alex: Hypothesis: smaller batches increase per-request kernel overhead for vector paths (memcopy + kernel launch) — token path amortizes differently. Need kernel counters to confirm.

mike: Quick mitigation: revert adaptive-window flag for embeddings models only. I'll prepare a canary rollback on xgpu-03.

jen: Customer impact: acme-corp prod only (high QPS of short inputs). They're hitting SLO, cost spike ~3x for same observed throughput.

sam-cust: Appreciate rapid response. ETA on fix?

mike: Canary rollback started on xgpu-03 at 04:12 UTC. Monitoring now. :eyes:

alex: After rollback, batch_efficiency back to 0.42, vectors/sec recovered +58%. Leaving rollback in place while we investigate.

jen: Followups:
- eng: instrument kernel call counts per batch size
- alert: batch_efficiency drop >25%
- product: consider model-specific batching profiles

mike: I'll open GH issue #5123 with repro, traces, and assign to eng-runtime.

jen: Noted. We'll close the loop with the customer after postmortem. :white_check_mark:
